source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Kenji,

I’m attaching the concept board again because this round revealed where my previous feedback was unintentionally unclear. What I meant was not that the overall V should become taller or more slender; the confident silhouette and stance we’ve already developed should remain intact.

My response to the reference was specifically about the right arm. If it extended only a little farther before terminating, that extra reach could create a quiet sense of purpose and aspiration without making the letter seem delicate.

This round increased the V’s overall height, whereas I had hoped to keep the same confident stance and lengthen only the gesture of the right arm.

We are very close, so I don’t think a new direction is necessary. Please refine Option 1 with that single adjustment in mind, and thank you for the work on this round.

value_updates.right_arm_terminal_reach: Extend the right arm only slightly farther before termination while preserving Option 1's established confident stance.

decisions.reason: Refining the Hero V's proportions does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
